messages.subject: Batting order
messages.text:
Hey, can you tell me a little more about this batting? Like, it seems to have a top and bottom covering layer of non-woven material. Is this to be removed when sewing it up?

Do you have any more instructions for special handling or examples?

It doesn’t look like Lasclay uses this batting in any of their products. And there is Kapok in the mix. Have a look at your English translation for materials description (there is an error, but I figured it out from the French)

What would be a suitable fabric to cover this with to fashion a sleeping mat or stargazing mat, for that’s what I want to do!

Thanks for your help!

I’m excited about the possibilities!

Kathryn Bräul

Sent from my iPhone

Sorry again for how long this took, we owed you a proper answer a long time ago.
